name: Familiar Strike
body:
When your familiar delivers touch spells, it is a sneak attack.

Prerequisite(s): Deliver touch spells class feature, familiar class feature, assassin level 1st.

Benefit(s): You can temporarily strengthen the empathic bond between you and your familiar, granting it your sneak attack ability. When your familiar delivers a touch spell for you that deals damage, you can use your empathic link to guide it as a standard action. If the touch attack hits, the familiar delivers the spell and adds your sneak attack damage to the spell’s damage.
